visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a vibrant red strapless dress and sunglasses walks across a vast, parched salt flat under a bright, high-contrast sun. Her dress billows in the wind against the white, cracked earth. (2) Indoors at night, the woman holds a small cup to her mouth, appearing contemplative in a dimly lit setting. She is wearing a white Adidas t-shirt. (3) An outdoor ritualistic scene shows a group of men with intricate white body paint standing and squatting. One man holds a staff, while the woman in the center raises an arm. (4) At dusk, the woman walks between massive, ancient Baobab trees. The lighting is soft and purple-toned. (5) She films herself in a selfie perspective while walking through an urban street, wearing a yellow headband and a denim vest over a black top. (6) On a windy airport tarmac, she stands near a large military transport aircraft, her hair blowing wildly across her face. (7) Inside a small shop with yellow walls, she waves her hand at two local men sitting among shelves of products. (8) She is seen riding inside a local minibus with red-patterned curtains, smiling and resting her chin on her hand while looking out. (9) A man in a white t-shirt and a green-and-red patterned sarong walks down a sunny street, carrying a phone. (10) A group of men are gathered under a shaded outdoor market area, sitting on chairs and looking toward the camera. (11) A wide shot shows a beach with light-colored sand and turquoise water, with a small sign featuring a red 'X' in the foreground. (12) Inside a room, two cats are lying flat on a tiled floor near a red fire extinguisher, seemingly resting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 真的沒想到三年過後 [Logo]: @elephant_gogo. (2) [Subtitle]: 我又回到了非洲了. (3) [Subtitle]: 去年去趟死藤水之後呢. (4) [Subtitle]: 我只是問了一下下一站要去哪裡. (5) [Subtitle]: 結果死藤水竟然跑出了 [Slogan]: 非洲. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以呢我這不就回來了嗎. (7) [Subtitle]: 大家好我是小象 這裡是非洲之角 [Slogan]: 吉布地. (8) [Subtitle]: 一个你可能连名字都念不出来的国家. (9) [Subtitle]: 然后真的是热得要命 [Variety]: 超熱. (10) [Subtitle]: 我一下飛機我真的一度以為 我下錯了星球?. (11) [Subtitle]: 想不到吉布地卻是世界上 最多國家來駐軍的地方!. (12) [Subtitle]: 非洲最安全的國家. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以顧名思義來到這個地方 不用擔心會被偷 不用擔心會被搶 也不用擔心什麼危險. (14) [Subtitle]: 出門在外還是要小心為甚. (15) [Subtitle]: 第二天我決定放棄冷氣房的舒適圈 走到外面好好來一場 [Slogan]: 吉布地大探險. (16) [Subtitle]: 但是這裡沒有交通工具 我又不想要走路 計程車又貴得要命 只能在路上攔了一台小巴. (17) [Subtitle]: 一上車後 我連要收多少錢都不知道. (18) [Subtitle]: 雞同鴨講的我們 連目的地在哪裡都不知道 我就跟著他們一起出發了. (19) [Subtitle]: 比如說開著小巴的小哥 會看著我一直說 [Variety]: Come on baby. (20) [Subtitle]: 但也好家在前面就有警察 所以我就跟他走 走了幾秒之後發現 前面根本什麼東西都沒有 只是二群男的在那邊喝茶聊天講八卦. (21) [Subtitle]: 最後我往這附近 好像很厲害的沙灘走去. (22) [Subtitle]: 嗯這個就是一個非常普通的沙灘. (23) [Subtitle]: 好我們回民宿吹冷氣吧. (24) [Subtitle]: 就這個樣子 我跟趴在我房門外的貓一樣 吹著冷氣舒舒服服的 度過下半天...
